_desc_num_parties: Number of parties involved in the MPC computation. Should match compiled application protocol.
_desc_party_ips: IP addresses of each party, ordered by party number
_desc_party_users: Usernames for each party, ordered by party number. Can be used by scripts to SSH into machines if necessary to start piranha processes
_desc_unit_test_only: Only run unit tests, do not try to run any full applications
_desc_debug_overflow: Test for overflow and print related debug output. Breaks security by revealing intermediary values.
_desc_run_name: Descriptive name for run, used to name log files with something useful
_desc_tra_param: For training data: batch size, the total number of data, number of features, tree depth
_desc_tree_iter_stats: Print acumulative runtime and communication statistics for each tree iteration (in level)
_desc_total_train_stats: Print acumulative runtime and communication statistics for whole training
_desc_all_Func_stats: Print acumulative runtime and communication statistics for each sub-protocols
_desc_self_define_scale: Determine if define the scale factor by users
_desc_scale_factor: scale factor is used to scale numerator and denominator in Gini Index
_desc_compute_GiniIndex_SGX: Choose the solution for computing Heuristic Measure (True: SGX; False: MPC)
_desc_compute_Gini_stats: print the run time for computing Gini Index
_desc_real_inf_param: For real inference data: the total number of inference data
_desc_accuracy_in_real_inf: Compute and print the accuracy in real inference
_desc_total_inference_stats: Print acumulative runtime and communication statistics for whole inference
_desc_if_simulate_inference: whether simulate inference or not for evaluation results
_desc_inf_param: For inference data: the total number of inference data, number of features, tree depth
